summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover for z.korkmaz@aegean.edu. Chain of evidence: (1) phishing email delivered from docusign-aegean-share.com at 07:52 and link clicked at 07:58 on 2026-10-14; (2) within one minute, an MFA-approved portal login from 203.0.113.77 (DigitalOcean, Amsterdam) — an anomalous cloud IP with no registered device; (3) repeated successful mail logins from 192.0.2.150 (OVH SAS, Gravelines, FR), a foreign hosting provider, with no device_id and no MFA, continuing through 03:10 on 10-15; (4) at 08:20:47, an inbox rule created via API moving mail to RSS Feeds — classic attacker concealment to hide compromise-related mail. This matches a full phishing → credential/MFA compromise → persistent cloud-based access → mail-rule manipulation ATO pattern, not explained by legitimate travel or behavior. Immediate containment: disable account, force password reset, revoke all sessions/app tokens, remove the malicious inbox rule, and reset MFA.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
